A.gmp_control_note: Critical zone; maintain qualified pressure cascade and minimize door opening.

B.gmp_control_note: Background to Grade A; maintain qualified pressure cascade.

C.gmp_control_note: Controlled cleanroom; maintain approved pressure cascade and access discipline.

D.gmp_control_note: Controlled cleanroom; use the approved site environmental limits.

immediate: Acknowledge alarm and record exact event time.
Verify the BMS value against a calibrated reference where required.
Place affected operation or material on QA hold when product impact is plausible.
corrective: Investigate sensor calibration, alarm configuration, door/interlock, and HVAC causes.
Review affected batch, exposure duration, environmental trends, and approved procedures.
Restore the qualified state and document QA disposition before release.
preventive: Trend alarms and recurring excursions by room and sensor.
Review preventive maintenance, calibration frequency, training, and alarm response instructions.
Perform CAPA effectiveness checks according to the approved CAPA procedure.
